description: Find contracts with action list and filters, read terms or an amendment with get, or read the root and its amendments with related. Resolve names before writes. Apps-capable hosts show a contract browser; other clients receive the same JSON. Contract lifecycle dates are separate from signing deadlines. Reads remain available when the tracking plan lapses.

counterparty.description: Part of the counterparty name, or its exact CPF/CNPJ.

end_date_from.description: Contracts ending on or after this date.

end_date_to.description: Contracts ending on or before this date.

ending_within_days.description: Contracts ending from today (the API's calendar day, Brasília time) to that many days later, both included; `0` is today. Any status: add `status=active` for the ones still in force.

external_id.description: ID of an external reference in that system.

external_system.description: System of an external reference, e.g. `hubspot`.

sort.description: `end_date` or `updated_at`; prefix with `-` for descending (`-updated_at`, the default). Contracts without an end date come last either way.

status.description: Contract status; several, comma-separated, match any of them.
